method: Geometry first on prims.pkl of l29. (1) Listed every INSERT (top level and nested in the linked blocks BA = UOBH_BTAR central file, BE = L01 ROOF central file, C2 = KPF facade) and grouped every A-DOOR, A-DOOR-FRAM, A-DOOR-HDLN primitive by source block: 18 blocks with A-DOOR geometry in or at the edge of the box (including the D_Openning_Lift family) plus the 2 Door-Opening families (their lines are on A-DETL); checked every swing-like arc in the box (15 arcs, all belong to listed doors). (2) Built the wall union from A-WALL, A-WALL-PATT and S-COLS hatch fills plus thin faces polygonised from A-WALL lines, took every short end face and ray-cast it along its normal to find end-to-end and end-to-side gaps (this found the stair nibs and the WC front gap and confirmed all door gaps); read exact a/b from the wall-end lines (+-1 cm), wall centre line and thickness from the wall hatches. (3) Looked at 24 tiles of 5 x 5 m (x -4.5..15.5 in 5 m steps, y -31..-61 in 5 m steps, grid 0.5, --inserts, 2000 px: png/tiles/t_x*_y*.png) and zooms of the NW WC, south WC, stair/core strip, lobby riser box, printer notch, corridor crossings and SW facade corner. (4) Rendered the part in three strips with a numbered --mark at the centre of every listed opening (png/marks_north.png, marks_mid.png, marks_south.png, marks_all.png) and checked that no gap, swing, leaf or sliding track is left without a marker. Conventions used: opening = between wall-end faces incl. frame, on the wall centre line; lift doors measured between the shaft wall ends; sliding doors between the fixed side panels; toilet cubicle doors (A-GENM Parametric_Toilet_stall, leaf drawn) listed as optional doors; lift opening without leaf listed as optional passage. No windows exist in this part; the facade is continuous curtain wall (listed under glassWalls).
